benchmark_metadata.telemetry_note: Evaluated against historical speed profile; live telemetry blender not active during offline benchmark.
benchmark_metadata.router_architecture: Frequency-based journey timing with timetable-based OD feasibility checks (not exact timetable-synchronized routing)

route_count_reconciliation.inactive_both_label: Inactive at both audit times (08:00 and 23:00); service patterns outside these probe hours remain uncharacterized unless further schedule analysis is conducted.
route_count_reconciliation.unobserved_routes_limitation: Absence of 462 routes from the 4 sampled telemetry dates indicates only that zero valid GPS pings mapped to these routes on those dates; it does not establish the root operational cause (e.g. unscheduled, telemetry hardware offline, or canceled).

corridor_reconstruction.dwell_treatment: Intermediate segment observation durations summed (includes on-link deceleration, passenger boarding/alighting dwell, and traffic delays); terminal turnaround layovers excluded.
corridor_reconstruction.observed_interval_definition: Elapsed time between linear-interpolated shape crossings at origin and destination stop coordinates (t_end - t_start).
corridor_reconstruction.scheduled_interval_definition: Difference between GTFS scheduled arrival/departure times across consecutive stops.

statistical_definitions.RMSE: Root Mean Squared Error: sqrt((1/N) * sum((y_true - y_pred)^2))

trace_example_corridor_0.sequence_break: Row seq=0..3 occurred at hour 15 (durations: 101.7s, 178.3s, 24.1s, 36.3s), followed immediately by row seq=4 at hour 6 (75.7s), representing a 9-hour backwards temporal discontinuity.
trace_example_corridor_0.underlying_cause: Validation Parquet (bus_movements_2026_10_29.parquet) only retains [segment_id, dow, hour, duration_sec]. Vehicle ID, trip ID, and raw pings were discarded during extraction to optimize storage. Sorting by [shape_id, seq] arbitrarily concatenated observations from different buses and times of day.

three_level_metric_distinction.segment_prediction_accuracy: Held-out single-segment evaluation on 1,147,748 physical observations (MAE 24.20s vs Sched 34.94s, +30.74% error reduction) is empirically verified, zero-leakage, and completely valid.
three_level_metric_distinction.shape_aggregation: Sum of speed-profile segment predictions along a route link sequence; valid as expected static route traversal time under profile speeds.
three_level_metric_distinction.same_vehicle_corridor_accuracy: Evaluating actual end-to-end journey time of a single bus requires continuous vehicle/trip identifiers and monotonic timestamps, which are absent in the segment parquet. Hence, corridor MAE/RMSE is withdrawn as same-vehicle evidence.

test_semantics.unit_test_scope: test_corridor_continuity_logic() validates synthetic vehicle-aware grouping helper logic ONLY under simulated vehicle-aware records.
test_semantics.production_parquet_status: Does NOT validate production Parquet-based corridor reconstruction, where vehicle_id, trip_id, and timestamps were discarded during ingestion. Production same-vehicle continuity cannot be claimed from segment parquets.

withdrawn_metrics.explanation: Measures topological sum of speed-profile segment estimates on consecutive links, NOT observed same-bus passenger journey time.

unresolved_data_limitations: Static GTFS stop_times specify scheduled arrivals, but intermediate dwell is not disaggregated from running time in vehicle position updates.
GTFS-RT vehicle telemetry lacks passenger load metrics (crowding/occupancy), preventing passenger discomfort or boarding denial modeling.
Footpath transfers use Euclidean distance with a 1.25 Manhattan detour factor at 1.2 m/s; grade-separated skywalks or pedestrian subways are not geometrically modeled.
Late-night routing availability reflects GTFS timetable schedules; real-world ad-hoc cancellations or unscheduled night trips are unobserved without live RT.
